layouts.name: Chengdu Circuit
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The independently mapped 2017 full circuit retains the long northern straight, eastern acute return and both western and southern lobes. The FIA historical circuit list identifies Chengdu International at 3.36 km. Its 3338.2 m source route matches the catalogue branch identity and remains unscaled against the 3348 m timing scalar. It represents the former full circuit rather than newer Chengdu venues; historical alignment remains draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3338.2 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
